items.title: 阿曼｜10月起大批基本食品、药品及医疗设备实行0% VAT
items.title_en: Oman | Zero VAT applies to broad categories of basic food, medicines and medical equipment from October
items.summary: 阿曼税务局自2026年10月1日起实施三项新行政决定，将大量基本食品、人用药品与医疗设备、兽药与兽医设备纳入0% VAT范围，直接降低相关进口与流通环节税负。
items.summary_en: Oman's Tax Authority implemented three new administrative decisions from 1 October 2026, applying a 0% VAT rate to broad categories of basic food products, human medicines and medical equipment, as well as veterinary medicines and equipment.
items.why_it_matters: 这项政策直接影响进口成本与终端价格，对食品、医疗、兽医及冷链供应链具有现实商业价值，也提高相关中国供应商进入阿曼市场的价格竞争力。
items.why_it_matters_en: The policy directly reduces tax costs and affects end-market pricing across food, healthcare, veterinary and cold-chain supply chains, improving the competitiveness of relevant exporters and suppliers entering Oman.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注食品供应商、医疗耗材与设备、兽医产品、冷链、进口代理、分销渠道及与阿曼本地进口商合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track food suppliers, medical consumables and equipment, veterinary products, cold chain, import agencies, distribution channels and partnerships with Omani importers.

items.title: 摩洛哥｜Fez大体育场启动两项国际招标，总额约MAD15.2亿
items.title_en: Morocco | Fez Grand Stadium launches two international tenders worth about MAD1.52bn
items.summary: 摩洛哥为Fez Grand Stadium升级启动两项国际招标，总估值约MAD1.52 billion。第一包约MAD1.291 billion，涉及高低压电气系统；第二包覆盖给排水、消防、空调、通风和排烟等系统。
items.summary_en: Morocco has launched two international tenders for the upgrade of Fez Grand Stadium with a combined estimated value of about MAD1.52 billion, covering high- and low-voltage electrical systems as well as plumbing, fire protection, HVAC, ventilation and smoke extraction.
items.why_it_matters: 这是2030世界杯准备周期中的明确工程采购，MEP和技术系统占比高，供应链切入点清晰。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a concrete procurement package within Morocco's 2030 World Cup preparation cycle, with substantial MEP and technical-systems scope.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注高低压配电、变压器、开关柜、BMS、消防、HVAC、风管、水泵、阀门、照明、弱电及与摩洛哥本地总包/MEP商合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Target MV/LV distribution, transformers, switchgear, BMS, fire systems, HVAC, ducting, pumps, valves, lighting, ELV and partnerships with Moroccan main contractors and MEP firms.

items.title: 墨西哥｜Mexico–Querétaro客运铁路启动DMU+ERTMS列车采购
items.title_en: Mexico | Mexico–Querétaro passenger rail launches DMU + ERTMS train procurement
items.summary: Mexico–Querétaro Passenger Train项目于2026年10月6日发布Passenger DMU Trains Equipped with ERTMS采购公告，标志项目从线路建设进一步进入车辆与信号系统采购阶段。
items.summary_en: The Mexico–Querétaro Passenger Train project issued a procurement notice on 6 October 2026 for passenger DMU trains equipped with ERTMS, marking a shift from civil works into rolling-stock and signalling procurement.
items.why_it_matters: 车辆与ERTMS属于高技术含量采购，比一般土建更适合轨道交通设备商和系统集成商切入。
items.why_it_matters_en: Rolling stock and ERTMS are high-value technical packages, creating a stronger entry point for rail equipment manufacturers and systems integrators than general civil works.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注DMU列车、ERTMS、车载信号、通信、制动、车门、空调、牵引辅助系统、检修设备及与墨西哥本地轨交企业合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Target DMU trains, ERTMS, onboard signalling, communications, braking, doors, HVAC, auxiliary traction systems, depot equipment and local rail partnerships.

items.title: 西班牙｜ADIF新发全国高铁设施与设备检查服务招标
items.title_en: Spain | ADIF launches nationwide high-speed rail facilities and equipment inspection tender
items.summary: 西班牙ADIF于2026年10月6日发布新招标，对运营中的高铁线路开展法规要求的设施与设备检查、复核和工程检验服务。
items.summary_en: Spain's ADIF published a new tender on 6 October 2026 for regulatory inspection, verification and engineering review services across facilities and equipment on operating high-speed rail lines.
items.why_it_matters: 这是全国高铁运营体系级的专业检测与维护采购，具备持续性服务需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a network-level professional inspection and maintenance procurement across Spain's high-speed rail system, creating recurring technical-service demand.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注铁路检测、结构监测、电气检测、轨道检测、设备校验、传感器、数据采集、工程咨询及本地技术伙伴。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track rail inspection, structural monitoring, electrical and track inspection, equipment calibration, sensors, data acquisition, engineering consultancy and local technical partners.

items.title: 西班牙｜ADIF西北车站低压电气设施维护新招标
items.title_en: Spain | ADIF launches low-voltage station electrical maintenance tender in the northwest
items.summary: ADIF于2026年10月6日发布西北区域车站低压电气设施维护服务招标，面向车站电气系统持续运维与保障。
items.summary_en: ADIF published a tender on 6 October 2026 for maintenance services covering low-voltage electrical installations at stations in Spain's northwest region.
items.why_it_matters: 属于长期运维型铁路市场，适合设备商与服务商形成持续收入。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a recurring operations-and-maintenance market that can support sustained revenue for equipment and service providers.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注低压配电柜、UPS、照明、配电系统、备件、检测、维护、能耗管理及铁路设施运维合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Target LV switchboards, UPS, lighting, distribution systems, spare parts, testing, maintenance, energy management and rail-facility O&M partnerships.

items.title: 墨西哥｜Coatzacoalcos III大桥国际招标进入收标节点
items.title_en: Mexico | Coatzacoalcos III Bridge international tender reaches bid-closing stage
items.summary: Coatzacoalcos III Bridge项目采用International Tender Under Treaty，2026年10月6日完成proposal reception，计划10月15日定标、10月16日签约，合同期延续至2030年。
items.summary_en: The Coatzacoalcos III Bridge project is being procured under an International Tender Under Treaty process. Proposal reception closed on 6 October 2026, with award scheduled for 15 October and contract signing for 16 October, with execution extending to 2030.
items.why_it_matters: 这是开放国际参与的大型桥梁基础设施项目，且本地化要求明确，适合中国供应链与墨西哥本地伙伴联合切入。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a major bridge infrastructure project open to international participation, with clear localization requirements that favor structured partnerships between international suppliers and Mexican contractors.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注桥梁钢结构、支座、伸缩缝、预制件、混凝土、排水、照明、交通安全设施、施工机械及本地联合体。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Target bridge steelwork, bearings, expansion joints, precast components, concrete, drainage, lighting, road-safety systems, construction machinery and local consortium partners.

items.title: 墨西哥｜Cuautla–Tlapa–Marquelia公路国际招标完成收标
items.title_en: Mexico | Cuautla–Tlapa–Marquelia road international tender completes bid reception
items.summary: Cuautla–Tlapa–Marquelia公路项目采用International Tender Under Treaty，包括约18公里道路现代化及80公里养护工程，2026年10月6日收标，计划10月15日定标、10月16日签约，合同周期4年。
items.summary_en: The Cuautla–Tlapa–Marquelia road project is being procured under an International Tender Under Treaty process and includes about 18 km of road modernization plus 80 km of maintenance. Bids closed on 6 October 2026, with award planned for 15 October and contract signing for 16 October.
items.why_it_matters: 这是多年度公路建设与维护项目，国际参与规则和本地化要求明确，后续供应链持续性较强。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a multi-year road construction and maintenance package with clear international participation and localization rules, creating a sustained downstream supply-chain opportunity.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注沥青、护栏、桥涵、排水、标线标牌、照明、施工机械、道路养护设备及与墨西哥本地承包商合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Target asphalt, barriers, bridges and culverts, drainage, markings and signage, lighting, construction machinery, road-maintenance equipment and Mexican contractor partnerships.
